add_definitions(-Dstrcasecmp=_stricmp)

# tftpd.exe is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/tftpd-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(tftpd_shims OBJECT tftpd.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tftpd_shims PRIVATE libadvapi32 libws2_32 libiphlpapi libmsvcrt libkernel32)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(tftpd_shims PRIVATE -Wno-format-overflow)
endif()
add_cargo_module(tftpd tftpd-cargo tftpd.exe
    KIND win32exe
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS tftpd_shims)
